brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four bases (piece 0,0 / 1,0 / 2,0 / 3,0), joined by jointBolt:0#0,0#0, 0#1,0#0 and 0#2,0#0. Each holds a drained planter tray (bin hex-bin-third-drain). Third depth is the deepest bin that fits above the pipe.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases
requirements.evidence: run:run-1, irrigation mode, enters at the outer east edge of (3,0) and passes through (2,0), (1,0) and (0,0) at level 0.
All four cells are on run-1's path, so the pipe passes under every bin. This checks how the parts fit, not water flow.
check_build: ok, meshClash clear, no errors or warnings. One info note: 18 outer faces could take caps (none fitted).

finish.summary: I built a four-cell planter: four full hex bases in a straight row at (0,0) to (3,0), joined at each of the three shared walls with joint bolts. One pipe run (run-1, irrigation mode) goes in through the outer east edge of (3,0) and passes through all four bases. Each cell holds a drained third-depth bin. A pipe running sideways through a cell only leaves room for third-depth bins, so each cell holds about 37 mm of soil. check_build found no rule errors and the mesh-collision check came back clear. It also noted, as info only, that 18 outer faces could take caps; I didn't fit any caps or covers.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
